title: Amerah24
script:
-- Amerah Delta Universal v2 (Works on all games)
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
local Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
local SpeedBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
local JumpBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
local FlyBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
local ResetBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")

-- إعدادات الواجهة
ScreenGui.Parent = game.CoreGui
Frame.Parent = ScreenGui
Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15) -- أسود غامق
Frame.BorderSizePixel = 2
Frame.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255) -- إطار نيوني
Frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 250)
Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.3, 0)
Frame.Active = true
Frame.Draggable = true 

Title.Parent = Frame
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35)
Title.Text = "AMERAH MULTI"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255)
Title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)

-- وظيفة السرعة (تعديل مباشر)
SpeedBtn.Parent = Frame
SpeedBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 40)
SpeedBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.2, 0)
SpeedBtn.Text = "سرعة خارقة (100)"
SpeedBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 100
end)

-- وظيفة القفزة (نطة عالية)
JumpBtn.Parent = Frame
JumpBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 40)
JumpBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.4, 0)
JumpBtn.Text = "نطة عالية (150)"
JumpBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.JumpPower = 150
end)

-- زر الطيران الشامل
FlyBtn.Parent = Frame
FlyBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 40)
FlyBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.6, 0)
FlyBtn.Text = "تفعيل الطيران ✈️"
FlyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XNEOFF/FlyGuiV3/main/FlyGuiV3.lua"))()
end)

-- زر إعادة الضبط (يرجعك طبيعية)
ResetBtn.Parent = Frame
ResetBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 40)
ResetBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.8, 0)
ResetBtn.Text = "إلغاء كل شيء"
ResetBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 0, 0)
ResetBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
    game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.JumpPower = 50
end)
